test_item:
DebugAuth should be a native layer daemon.
(DebugAuth runs as a native daemon after the head unit boots)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. The head unit has completed a boot cycle
proc:
1. Read the running native processes on the DUT
$ adb shell ps -A
er: 1. The adb shell ps -A output lists the DebugAuth native daemon
design: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
author: PeiPYHsu
remarks:
source: 037 SWE1-SAM-0002 Requirement Description and Verification Criteria
sibling axis: process form; rule 1 of SEC-04 4.2
